verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own bulk-ingestion features: a 'Spreadsheet Import' option on the pricing page and a support article on 'Add Multiple Companies Using Template', both of which create many records at once. Cap-table migration from Pulley or Carta is also documented, though the white-glove version is largely a vendor service. There is no evidence of bulk edit, bulk issuance or bulk actions across existing stakeholders or securities, nor of programmatic or API-driven batch operations suited to an AI-native user. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete of existing items, bulk share issuance or e-sign actions, API or scriptable batch operations, hands-on corroboration.
